weeks.title: Hello, small one
weeks.summary: Arjun arrived eleven weeks early. He spent his first days resting while machines did some of the work, and on day 6 you held him for the first time.
weeks.hardPart: Most babies lose a little weight in their first days. Arjun dropped to 900 g by day 5, which the team expected, and began gaining it back.

weeks.title: Finding a rhythm
weeks.summary: Feeds grew from drops to full feeds of Mom's milk. On day 12 he was back to his birth weight, and on day 14 he tried a gentler kind of breathing help.

weeks.title: A harder week
weeks.summary: This week asked more of Arjun. He gained slowly and needed more help breathing again. You kept coming; on the hardest days your voice was there.
weeks.hardPart: On day 17 his breathing pauses came more often, and the team moved him back to CPAP. This is common for babies born this early and usually means the lungs need more time. The care team called you that afternoon; the plan was to give his lungs rest.

weeks.title: Steadying
weeks.summary: The pauses settled. Dad held him skin-to-skin for the first time, and Arjun had his first bath.

weeks.title: Breathing more on his own
weeks.summary: On day 31 Arjun came off CPAP for good and moved to soft high-flow tubes. You could see his whole face for the first time in weeks.
weeks.hardPart: His first eye exam on day 30 was routine. Babies born this early are checked every one to two weeks; the team will share each result with you.

weeks.title: First bottle
weeks.summary: Arjun wore his first outfit and, on day 38, took milk from a bottle for the first time: a few careful sips, then a rest.

weeks.title: Learning to feed
weeks.summary: More bottles, a first try at the breast, and his breathing help turned down to a whisper of oxygen.

weeks.title: Room to breathe
weeks.summary: Arjun is breathing room air and sleeping in an open crib. This chapter is still being written.
